<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Damien & Lulu</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,wght@1,300&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--s1:#07021a;--s2:#1a0840;--s3:#3b0f6b;--g1:#10042a;--g2:#050113;--bld:#12062e;--night:#14122b;--pink:#f7c6d9;--rose:#ee8fb3;--white:#fff8fb;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
body[data-style=watercolor]{--s1:#7f78c2;--s2:#b9a6e0;--s3:#f2c4da;--g1:#a58fc9;--g2:#7d6ab0;--bld:#8a7bbd}
body[data-style=neon]{--s1:#07021a;--s2:#1a0840;--s3:#3b0f6b;--g1:#10042a;--g2:#050113;--bld:#12062e}
body[data-style=ink]{--s1:#1d1b3a;--s2:#35296a;--s3:#6a58a6;--g1:#2a2150;--g2:#161233;--bld:#231c4a}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--night)}
body{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--white)}
.sky{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--s1) 0%,var(--s2) 45%,var(--s3) 74%,var(--g1) 74.1%,var(--g2) 100%)}
.glow{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 55% at 50% 30%,rgba(255,216,154,.22),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 14% at 50% 80%,rgba(247,198,217,.22),transparent 70%)}
.top{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:24%}
.bg{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:26%;width:100%;height:74%}
.bld rect{fill:var(--bld)}
canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.stage{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:14%;height:68%}
.stage svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;overflow:visible}
h1{position:absolute;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 60px);left:0;right:0;margin:0;text-align:center;font:italic 300 clamp(24px,5vw,40px)/1.1 Fraunces,Georgia,serif;text-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(20,18,43,.8)}
.bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 14px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
button{font:inherit;font-size:17px;color:#3b2f6e;background:var(--pink);border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 28px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 22px rgba(238,143,179,.45)}
.chip{font-size:14px;padding:7px 14px;color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,248,251,.16);box-shadow:none}
.chip[aria-pressed=true]{color:#3b2f6e;background:var(--pink)}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--white);outline-offset:3px}
input[type=range]{width:110px;accent-color:var(--rose)}
#msg{margin:0;min-height:1.2em;font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:0 16px;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(5,1,19,.9)}
.lamp{animation:flick 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.l2{animation-delay:-3s}
.tw{animation:tw 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.tw.b{animation-delay:-2.5s}
.stars circle,.bulbs circle{animation:tw 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.stars circle:nth-child(2n),.bulbs circle:nth-child(2n){animation-delay:-1.5s}
@keyframes flick{from{opacity:.8}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes tw{from{opacity:.55}to{opacity:1}}
.couple{transform-origin:180px 470px;animation:sway 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.move{animation:waltz 40s ease-in-out infinite}
.hair-d{transform-origin:140px 196px;animation:hair 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.skirt{transform-origin:202px 350px;animation:skirt 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.head-l{transform-origin:206px 292px;animation:tilt 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.spin{transform-origin:206px 300px;animation:twirl 40s ease-in-out infinite}
.flare{transform-origin:202px 350px;animation:flare 40s ease-in-out infinite}
.dipL{transform-origin:206px 470px;animation:dip 40s ease-in-out infinite}
.touchD{transform-origin:140px 300px;animation:tD 40s ease-in-out infinite}
.touchL{transform-origin:206px 292px;animation:tL 40s ease-in-out infinite}
.hug{animation:hug 40s infinite}.reach{transform-origin:164px 310px;animation:hug 40s infinite,reach 40s ease-in-out infinite}
.lift{opacity:0;animation:lift 40s infinite}
.hrt{opacity:0;animation:float 6s ease-out infinite}
.hairB,.dressB{opacity:0;animation:hb 40s infinite}.faceF,.nk{animation:fF 40s infinite}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-6px) rotate(-1.8deg)}50%{transform:translateX(6px) rotate(1.8deg)}}
@keyframes hair{0%,100%{transform:rotate(2.5deg)}50%{transform:rotate(-2.5deg)}}
@keyframes skirt{0%,100%{transform:scaleX(.97)}50%{transform:scaleX(1.06)}}
@keyframes tilt{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-3deg)}50%{transform:rotate(2deg)}}
@keyframes waltz{0%,52%{transform:translate(0,0)}56%{transform:translate(-30px,-4px)}60%{transform:translate(0,0)}64%{transform:translate(30px,-4px)}68%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}}
@keyframes twirl{0%,25%{transform:scaleX(1)}27.5%{transform:scaleX(.14)}30%{transform:scaleX(-1)}32.5%{transform:scaleX(.14)}35%,100%{transform:scaleX(1)}}
@keyframes hb{0%,27.4%{opacity:0}27.5%,32.5%{opacity:1}32.6%,100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes fF{0%,27.4%{opacity:1}27.5%,32.5%{opacity:0}32.6%,100%{opacity:1}}
@keyframes flare{0%,24%{transform:scaleX(1)}30%{transform:scaleX(1.3)}36%,100%{transform:scaleX(1)}}
@keyframes hug{0%,25%{opacity:1}25.5%,34.5%{opacity:0}35%,100%{opacity:1}}
@keyframes lift{0%,25%{opacity:0}25.5%,34.5%{opacity:1}35%,100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes dip{0%,38%{transform:rotate(0)}41%,44%{transform:rotate(14deg)}47.5%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}}
@keyframes reach{0%,38%{transform:scale(1)}41%,44%{transform:scale(1.45,1.24)}47.5%,100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes tD{0%,76%{transform:rotate(0)}80%,86%{transform:rotate(9deg)}90%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}}
@keyframes tL{0%,76%{transform:rotate(0)}80%,86%{transform:rotate(-9deg)}90%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}}
@keyframes float{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.6);opacity:0}15%{opacity:.9}100%{transform:translate(var(--dx,0),-85px) scale(1);opacity:0}}
.hold *{animation-play-state:paused!important}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.couple,.move,.hair-d,.skirt,.head-l,.spin,.flare,.dipL,.touchD,.touchL,.reach,.hrt,.lift,.hug,.hairB,.dressB,.faceF,.nk{animation:none}.lift{opacity:0}}
</style>
</head>

<filter id="wc" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".035" numOctaves="2" seed="3" result="n"/><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale="5" xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G" result="d"/><feGaussianBlur in="d" stdDeviation=".6" result="b"/><feColorMatrix in="b" type="saturate" values=".8"/></filter>
<filter id="neon" x="-20%" y="-10%" width="140%" height="120%"><feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="1.6" result="s"/><feGaussianBlur in="s" stdDeviation="5" result="g1"/><feColorMatrix in="g1" type="matrix" values="1.4 0 .3 0 0 0 .5 .6 0 0 .6 0 1.4 0 0 0 0 0 1.6 0" result="g2"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="g2"/><feMergeNode in="s"/></feMerge></filter>
<filter id="ink" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%"><feMorphology in="SourceAlpha" operator="dilate" radius="1.6" result="d"/><feFlood flood-color="#1a1226"/><feComposite in2="d" operator="in" result="o"/><feComponentTransfer in="SourceGraphic" result="p"><feFuncR type="discrete" tableValues="0 .3 .55 .8 1"/><feFuncG type="discrete" tableValues="0 .3 .55 .8 1"/><feFuncB type="discrete" tableValues="0 .3 .55 .8 1"/></feComponentTransfer><feMerge><feMergeNode in="o"/><feMergeNode in="p"/></feMerge></filter>

<canvas id="front"></canvas>
<h1>Damien &amp; Lulu</h1>
<div class="bar">
<div class="row"><button id="play" type="button">Play</button>
<input id="vol" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="1" aria-label="Volume"></div>
<p id="msg" role="status"></p>
</div>
<audio id="song" loop preload="none" playsinline></audio>
<script>(function(){
var reduce=window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
var cb=document.getElementById('back'),cf=document.getElementById('front');
var xb=cb.getContext('2d'),xf=cf.getContext('2d'),W=0,H=0,dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
function size(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;[cb,cf].forEach(function(c){c.width=W*dpr;c.height=H*dpr});xb.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);xf.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
size();addEventListener('resize',size);
var RC={storybook:'215,225,255',watercolor:'255,255,255',neon:'110,245,255',ink:'235,235,255'},rc=RC.neon;
var N=reduce?70:220,drops=[],rip=[];
function gy(n){return H*(0.74+n*0.23)}
function make(){var n=0.08+Math.random()*0.92;return{x:Math.random()*(W+160)-40,y:Math.random()*H,n:n}}
for(var i=0;i<N;i++)drops.push(make());
var last=performance.now();
function frame(t){
var dt=Math.min((t-last)/1000,.05);last=t;
xb.clearRect(0,0,W,H);xf.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
for(var i=0;i<drops.length;i++){
var d=drops[i],n=d.n,sp=420+n*1000,len=7+n*38,c=n<0.5?xb:xf;
d.y+=sp*dt;d.x-=sp*dt*0.14;
var g=gy(n);

c.strokeStyle='rgba('+rc+','+(0.16+n*0.55)+')';
c.lineWidth=0.5+n*2.4;c.lineCap='round';

c.beginPath();c.moveTo(d.x+len*0.14,d.y-len);c.lineTo(d.x,d.y);c.stroke();c.shadowBlur=0}

var a=document.getElementById('song'),b=document.getElementById('play'),v=document.getElementById('vol'),m=document.getElementById('msg');
var mode='',ac=null,gain=null,buf=null,src=null,blobUrl=null,playing=false;
document.body.classList.add('hold');
function bytes(){var s=atob(B64),u=new Uint8Array(s.length);for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++)u[i]=s.charCodeAt(i);return u}
function setState(on){playing=on;b.textContent=on?'Pause':'Play';document.body.classList.toggle('hold',!on)}
function say(x,ms){m.textContent=x;if(ms)setTimeout(function(){if(m.textContent===x)m.textContent=''},ms)}
function ensureAC(){try{if(!ac){ac=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();gain=ac.createGain();gain.gain.value=+v.value;gain.connect(ac.destination)}if(ac.state==='suspended')ac.resume()}catch(e){ac=null}}
function startWA(){
if(!ac){say('Your browser blocked the sound.');return}
function go(){if(src){try{src.stop()}catch(e){}}src=ac.createBufferSource();src.buffer=buf;src.loop=true;src.connect(gain);src.start(0);mode='wa';if(ac.state==='suspended')ac.resume();setState(true);say('Playing. No sound? Turn off silent mode and turn your volume up.',7000)}
if(buf){go();return}
say('Loading the song...');
var ok=function(bb){buf=bb;go()},bad=function(){say("Couldn't load the song.")};
var p=ac.decodeAudioData(bytes().buffer,ok,bad);if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(bad)}
function startEl(){
try{if(!blobUrl){blobUrl=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes()],{type:'audio/mpeg'}));a.src=blobUrl}}catch(e){startWA();return}
a.volume=+v.value;
var p=a.play();
if(p&&p.then)p.then(function(){mode='el';setState(true);say('Playing. No sound? Turn your volume up.',7000)}).catch(startWA);
else{mode='el';setState(true)}}
b.addEventListener('click',function(){
if(playing){if(mode==='el')a.pause();else if(ac)ac.suspend();setState(false);return}
ensureAC();
if(mode==='wa'&&ac){ac.resume();setState(true);return}
if(mode==='el'){a.play();setState(true);return}
startEl()});
v.addEventListener('input',function(){a.volume=+v.value;if(gain)gain.gain.value=+v.value});

})();</script>
